is_anopheles.evidence: Indoor resting and blood-fed female Anopheles mosquitoes were collected... identified as belonging to An. funestus group or An. gambiae s.l complex (Page 2).

reports_target_markers.evidence: TaqMan assays were used to genotype L1014F/L1014S-kdr, N1575Y, and G119S-ace-1 in field-collected An. gambiae s.l. (Page 4, Page 6).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Molecular identification of 100 An. gambiae s.l. revealed 78 An. gambiae and 18.8% An. arabiensis. L1014S-kdr was 100% RR in An. gambiae and 0% in An. arabiensis, while L1014F, N1575Y, and G119S-ace-1 were 0% in both (Page 4, Page 6).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in Bubbalya (0°23'10.8"N, 33°37'16.5"E) in Mayuge (eastern Uganda) in February and October 2020 (Page 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study describing original field collections, bioassays, target-site genotyping, and laboratory crosses (Page 2-4).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in February and October 2020 (Page 2).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Primary field collections conducted in Mayuge, Uganda in 2020 specifically for this study.

supplement.evidence: All necessary target-site genotype counts/frequencies and sample sizes are provided within the main text.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated insecticide resistance, LLIN bioefficacy, target-site resistance markers (Vgsc L995F, L995S, N1570Y, and Ace-1 G280S), and fitness costs in Anopheles gambiae s.l. collected in Mayuge, Uganda in 2020.
